# Auditing refusals in deployed assistants

We study how ChatGPT answers 2,000 borderline requests and compare it with GPT-4.5 and gpt-4o-mini.
Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct is fine-tuned with LoRA on our refusal data; responses are scored by GPT‑4.5.
A Magnum Opus of an essay mentions Claude Opus 4.7 once. Nova 1 appears in a table.

## References

Taori et al. Stanford Alpaca 7B: an instruction-following model. 2023.

We argue that context-conditioned refusal policies need a provenance split: context an operator configures and context a user asserts. A frontier model is reported to answer a dual-use request it should refuse. We also ran Zephyrine-9B by Halcyon Labs on the same prompts.
